name: Affinity
description: Affinity is Canva's professional-grade creative app that unifies vector design, photo editing, and page layout tools that were previously three separate apps (Designer, Photo, and Publisher), now free for everyone.
best_for: Professional and hobbyist designers who want a full desktop-grade design suite without a subscription, following Canva's acquisition of Affinity-maker Serif.
features: Vector design tools with pen tools and non-destructive editing
Raster photo editing in the same unified app
Page layout and publishing tools for multi-page documents
Typography with text-on-path and OpenType features
AI vector generation from text prompts
No subscription required — full professional feature set free, forever

alternatives.name: Sketch
